correctness.rationale: Makri Proposition 3.8 supplies G_k=F2^k semidirect LB2 with diagonal action; Brendle--Hatcher generators specialize LB2 to Z*C2 and act by the same transposition on H1(F2;Q). For each Kunneth summand the free-product Mayer--Vietoris sequence proves H0=W+ and a natural exact sequence 0→W+→H1→W-→0, while higher group homology vanishes rationally. The two-column Lyndon--Hochschild--Serre spectral sequence collapses, and additivity of traces proves the signed cycle-product formula. The script independently enumerates 874 exact permutation cases and matches closed characters and binomial Betti numbers. The proof does not treat integral or topological-space homology.

value.rationale: The complete permutation character is a natural infinite-family invariant of two-ring mixed-motion groups, exposing a subtle even-cycle correction hidden by numerical Betti numbers. It gives the S_k-representation on every rational group homology degree for any number of ordered points and connects new mixed-motion topology to group-homological structure. This is more informative than an individual numerical computation and supplies exact classifying-space homology without assuming the mixed configuration space is aspherical.
